name: hello
summary: Hello acceptance and every rejection: version, signature binding, unknown credential, non-member, frame before Hello, empty Hello, local sockets skip the signature, inadmissible proof.

name: append
summary: Appends are acknowledged only once durable; conflicts, zero-length appends, ownership, reads, tails, reads past the end and frames split across deliveries.

name: quota
summary: Quota refusals for appends and objects count stored bytes plus in-flight reservations; Account reports the space's accounting.

name: follow
summary: Follow, watch (Created), live Data pushes, FOLLOW_END, Unfollow and reserved stream ids.

name: feed
summary: The announce feed: snapshot from 0, live entries, resume at aligned and unaligned offsets, past-the-end, filters and additive filters.

name: list
summary: Listing returns each stream once, newest first, with its current length.

name: probe
summary: Probe answers lengths for streams, unknown streams and the feed, preceded by Hollow for based segments.

name: objects
summary: Put, deduplicated Put, Get, Missing, Forget and reader refusals.

name: drop
summary: Drop notifies followers and watchers once, appends FEED_DROPPED, refuses non-owners and busy streams.

name: redact
summary: Redaction zero-fills whole records in place, keeps offsets, logs the range in the feed, refuses readers and misaligned ranges.

name: hollow
summary: Hollow segments: Note, Noted, Hollow to followers and readers, Fill backward, mismatched Fill, appends after a hollow prefix.

name: pipe
summary: Peer pipe: Pull, Pulled, Serve, Served, final, none, unmatched frames, absent and self holders, duplicate tags, holder disconnect.

name: presence
summary: Presence snapshots and up/down transitions per device across several connections; direct messages and Undelivered.

name: membership
summary: Authorization follows the signed membership log: an Add appended to a members stream admits, a proof by a non-member is ignored, a Remove revokes live connections.

name: account
summary: Account namespace: request and account credentials may only see presence and exchange direct messages; requesters are limited to two connections.

name: embedder
summary: An embedder authorizer maps unknown credential types to principals; the relay enforces the access it grants.

name: malformed
summary: Malformed input is fatal: oversize frames, unknown kinds, relay-only kinds, short payloads, count mismatches, inverted ranges, bad bulk headers, oversize direct payloads, a second Hello; bytes after the error are ignored.

name: compaction
summary: Feed compaction folds the feed into a snapshot of current lengths plus the redaction log; followers and late readers resume from the new base.

name: trim
summary: Trim drops stored content below a base an archive covers: owner only, acknowledged once durable, idempotent, never lowers base, refused at or past the length; readers, probes and follows get Trimmed; Fill below a trim stores nothing.

name: limits
summary: Per-principal connection limit and per-connection follow limit.

name: live
summary: Live drafts (feature bit 3): live-only follows, Live forwarded unstored to live followers only, owner check, Unfollow leaving live interest, LIVE removal, draft pulls through the peer pipe, malformed Live.
